description: This file implements core functionality for the 'git update-ref' command, including parsing detailed argument inputs, handling reference updates, deletions, and validations within the Git version control system. It manages reference transaction workflows, including start, prepare, commit, and abort operations, and provides mechanisms for reading and processing input commands from stdin.

methods.name: const char * parse_arg(const char * next,struct strbuf * arg)
methods.description: Parses a whitespace- or NUL-terminated argument, handling C-style quoting, and appends it to a strbuf. Dies if quoting is malformed or the argument is invalid.

methods.name: char * parse_refname(const char ** next)
methods.description: Parses a reference name immediately following the command, handling quoting or raw input depending on configuration, and performs format validation.

methods.name: char * parse_next_refname(const char ** next)
methods.description: Wrapper around parse_refname that skips the delimiter after parsing.

methods.name: char * parse_next_arg(const char ** next)
methods.description: Wrapper around parse_arg that skips the delimiter after parsing.

methods.name: int parse_next_oid(const char ** next,const char * end,struct object_id * oid,const char * command,const char * refname,int flags)
methods.description: Parses an argument separator and fetches the next argument as a SHA-1 object ID, supporting optional empty value and validation.

methods.name: void parse_cmd_update(struct ref_transaction * transaction,const char * next,const char * end)
methods.description: Parses and executes an 'update' reference command within a transaction context.

methods.name: void parse_cmd_symref_update(struct ref_transaction * transaction,const char * next,const char * end UNUSED)
methods.description: Parses and executes a 'symref-update' command to update symbolic references.

methods.name: void parse_cmd_create(struct ref_transaction * transaction,const char * next,const char * end)
methods.description: Parses and executes a 'create' reference command.

methods.name: void parse_cmd_symref_create(struct ref_transaction * transaction,const char * next,const char * end UNUSED)
methods.description: Parses and executes a 'symref-create' command for symbolic reference creation.

methods.name: void parse_cmd_delete(struct ref_transaction * transaction,const char * next,const char * end)
methods.description: Parses and executes a 'delete' reference command.

methods.name: void parse_cmd_symref_delete(struct ref_transaction * transaction,const char * next,const char * end UNUSED)
methods.description: Parses and executes a 'symref-delete' command.

methods.name: void parse_cmd_verify(struct ref_transaction * transaction,const char * next,const char * end)
methods.description: Parses and verifies references against expected values.

methods.name: void parse_cmd_symref_verify(struct ref_transaction * transaction,const char * next,const char * end UNUSED)
methods.description: Parses and verifies symbolic references against expected targets.

methods.name: void report_ok(const char * command)
methods.description: Outputs a success message for a command.

methods.name: void parse_cmd_option(struct ref_transaction * transaction UNUSED,const char * next,const char * end UNUSED)
methods.description: Parses optional command options such as 'no-deref'.

methods.name: void parse_cmd_start(struct ref_transaction * transaction UNUSED,const char * next,const char * end UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'start' command to begin a transaction.

methods.name: void parse_cmd_prepare(struct ref_transaction * transaction,const char * next,const char * end UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'prepare' command to prepare a transaction.

methods.name: void parse_cmd_abort(struct ref_transaction * transaction,const char * next,const char * end UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'abort' command to abort a transaction.

methods.name: void print_rejected_refs(const char * refname,const struct object_id * old_oid,const struct object_id * new_oid,const char * old_target,const char * new_target,enum ref_transaction_error err,void * cb_data UNUSED)
methods.description: Outputs details about rejected reference updates during a transaction.

methods.name: void parse_cmd_commit(struct ref_transaction * transaction,const char * next,const char * end UNUSED)
methods.description: Commits a prepared transaction and outputs rejected updates.

methods.name: void update_refs_stdin(unsigned int flags)
methods.description: Main routine for processing reference commands from stdin, dispatching them to appropriate handlers within a transaction lifecycle.

methods.name: int cmd_update_ref(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main entry point for the 'git update-ref' command, parsing user input, and executing reference updates, deletions, or batch processing.
